## 4b7b6d3a3a14

**Reproduced distribution shortcut: every sampled motif uses one non-marker color.**

The intended task removes marker 1 or 2 and reflects the complete non-marker pattern horizontally or vertically. All four canonical demonstrations contain two motif colors. The audited validator accepts those multi-color canonical inputs, but the sampler collapsed the palette: in 300 draws—100 per band, `seed=5900+index`, `sample_index=index`—every input had exactly one motif color; 0/300 had multiple motif colors and 0/300 failed `self_check`. Markers 1 and 2 both appeared (144 and 156 samples). See `checks/audit/4b7b6d3a3a14/probe.json`.

A strong rival is **remove the marker and reflect only the dominant non-marker color**. It matches every sampled input because there is no secondary color to omit. On canonical train input 0, color 6 is dominant and color 4 is a one-cell secondary motif. The intended horizontal reflection creates color 4 at zero-based `(5,6)`; the rival leaves that cell zero while otherwise matching. Exact input, source/rule hashes, validator status, authoritative output, rival output, and the differing cell are retained in `checks/audit/4b7b6d3a3a14/counterexample.json`; the Racket receipt is `checks/audit/4b7b6d3a3a14/racket.json`.

The counterexample belongs to the validator’s domain but not the actual sampled distribution. Audit target source was not modified. The generator summary also appears stale about marker retention, but the source-bound shortcut above is the actionable teaching issue.

## 4b7b6d3a3a14

**Reproduced exact-control failure: the advertised `marker` override is ignored.**

At generator SHA-256
`149557cfe9a3d87d24ceb53dc23510e861b8686fea17ead915d581839ec63ba4`,
I made 600 exact marker requests: 100 requests for each marker value in each of
three bands, with seeds
`70000 + 10000*band_index + 1000*requested_marker + index`. The returned corner
marker disagreed with the request in 299/600 cases, and `self_check` accepted all
299 mismatches even when given the requested override in `meta`.

The retained witness requests `marker=2` at easy `seed=72000`,
`sample_index=0`, but returns marker 1 with no validator error. Replacing only
the corner with the requested marker 2 yields another validator-lawful input;
the two authoritative Racket outputs differ at 6 cells because one mirrors
horizontally and the other vertically. See
`checks/audit/4b7b6d3a3a14/counterexample.json`, `racket.json`, and
`requested-racket.json`.

The actual grid belongs to the default generated domain but not to the requested
`marker=2` slice. This finding is independent of the already-retained one-color
motif shortcut on the same unchanged source. This audit target was not modified.
